summary: Recent updates to the Firefox browser's negotiation engine, specifically within the JSEP (JavaScript Session Establishment Protocol), focus on enhancing the handling of media streaming and ensuring more efficient resource management. Key improvements include adopting a new method for managing RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) header extensions, which will streamline data transmission in real-time communications, as well as filtering out duplicate SSRCs (Synchronization Source Identifiers) during remote track setups to avoid potential conflicts. Additionally, the patches improve compatibility with Opus audio codec settings in SDP (Session Description Protocol) parsing, making voice calls clearer and more efficient. **These enhancements significantly optimize WebRTC, the technology behind video calls, ensuring a smoother and more reliable experience for users.**
